description: Returns free multiple-choice practice questions for one country, each with four options, the zero-based answerIndex of the correct option and a short explanation. Use it when the user wants to practise, be quizzed or see example questions. Clients that support MCP Apps show it as an interactive quiz card. This is a small free sample, not the full question bank (that is on the Civica site, see moreAt), and questions are independent study checks, not official exam questions.

country.description: Country name or id, e.g. "UK", "United Kingdom", "de", "Germany". Use list_tracks for valid values.

name: get_sample_questions

disclaimer.description: Independent-app notice; always show it with the facts.

moreAt.description: Where to find the full question bank.

answerIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct option.
